claims.claim_text_bounded: In the inspected ViEcomRec artifact, the released face-cleanser corpus contains 2,244 items, 369,099 reviews, and 304,708 users, with review date-time and a chronological leave-last-two evaluation protocol.
claims.support_scope: Only the ViEcomRec release and inspected accepted manuscript.

claims.claim_text_bounded: Among the reviewed Vietnamese candidates with acquired full artifacts, ViFoodRec and ViHoRec supply rating/review resources, while the restaurant-image work evaluates non-temporal rating regression; none independently provides all locked strict purchase, persistent-user, basket, timestamp, content, and candidate-universe fields.
claims.support_scope: Only the three named, acquired Vietnamese artifacts; no prevalence claim about all Vietnamese recommender research.
forbidden_extrapolations: Do not extend this reviewed-candidate result to all Vietnamese recommender systems.
Do not turn a rating or review into an observed purchase without source support.
counter_evidence: ViEcomRec has a stronger post-purchase review proxy but still lacks basket structure.

claims.claim_text_bounded: Amazon-M2 is suitable evidence for multilingual, content-rich session and next-engagement modeling, but its inspected task does not constitute strict H4 purchase replication because the target is the next interacted product and the schema does not establish persistent users across sessions.
forbidden_extrapolations: Do not label next engagement as purchase.
Do not infer a persistent user from a session identifier.
counter_evidence: The challenge language sometimes describes shopping intention or next purchase informally, but the formal task predicts the next engaged product.

claims.claim_text_bounded: The inspected Coveo release provides sessions, purchase and cart events, shifted timestamps, and item content, but no persistent user identifier; its pinned terms also prohibit redistribution and restrict use to non-commercial research and education.
claims.support_scope: Coveo SIGIR eCom paper and repository terms at the pinned revision.

forbidden_extrapolations: Do not infer redistribution permission from public download.
Do not treat a session hash as a persistent user.
counter_evidence: The release has a purchase event and rich content, making it structurally stronger than interaction-only session datasets on some fields.

claims.claim_text_bounded: Complete Journey is the closest reviewed external resource to the locked structural fields because the provider describes household-level purchases, transaction/basket structure, time, and product/marketing tables; its use remains conditional because the full edition was not acquired and provider terms do not grant general redistribution.
claims.support_scope: Provider source-files page, provider Terms & Conditions, and CRAN package metadata as separate rights layers.

claims.claim_text_bounded: RelBench rel-amazon and rel-hm are derivative adapters, not independent evidence or independent rights grants from Amazon Reviews or H&M; the current rel-amazon card states that its dataset license is not specified.
claims.support_scope: RelBench benchmark and the two named adapters only.
forbidden_extrapolations: Do not count adapters as independent upstream datasets.
Do not infer H&M redistribution rights from RelBench's MIT code license.
counter_evidence: RelBench adds independent benchmark/task-design evidence, but that is different from independent upstream data or rights evidence.

claims.claim_text_bounded: For the reviewed operational resources, availability, code/package license, paper license, and dataset rights/redistribution are independent layers and must be passed separately.
claims.support_scope: The reviewed resources demonstrate concrete layer mismatches: package CC0 versus provider terms, open paper versus unlicensed dataset, and public downloads without a dataset license.

forbidden_extrapolations: Availability does not imply redistribution permission.
A code or package license does not automatically license upstream data.
A paper license does not automatically license its dataset.
counter_evidence: OTTO and TAOBAO-MM provide explicit dataset-license statements; those rights findings rely on the statements, not on availability.

claims.claim_text_bounded: Across the 14 reviewed operational records, no candidate is passed unconditionally for the locked strict H4 replication: candidates with purchase structure have at least one unresolved persistent-user, basket, edition, acquisition, or rights constraint, and interaction-only candidates fail the purchase outcome.
claims.support_scope: Only the 14 operational records in this lane registry; no population prevalence claim.
forbidden_extrapolations: Do not claim no suitable dataset exists outside the reviewed candidates.
Do not convert this planning audit into an H4 result.
H4 remains NOT_RUN and NOT_TESTED.
counter_evidence: Complete Journey is structurally closest and may clear after exact edition acquisition and legal review.
Coveo and OTTO contain observed purchase/order events but lack persistent users.

claims.support_scope: TAOBAO-MM official data card and MUSE open-source evaluation only.
